summary: First full E2E run of JADORI prototype. Backend pytest 19/21 pass (2 minor validation gaps). Frontend: every requested flow was tested and works: home section order, doors/links, rent-door crossfade, brand strip + arrows + Dior filter, newsletter (error/success/already on list), catalogue filters/clear/Rent-Buy switch (6 buy-enabled: 01,03,05,07,09,12)/sort/brand chips, product gallery/thumbs/accordions/calendar/1-day error/breakdown/request-to-rent/request-to-buy, pending vs verified authenticity card, register (+agree error), 3-step listing -> lender dashboard, support form, mobile menu/doors swipe/2-col catalogue/mobile booking bar, grid 4/3/2 cols at 1920/1100/1099/860/859, style guide tokens. Bugs found: fee rounding mismatch between UI and backend, mobile catalogue horizontal overflow, and guest requests do not show in the account.

critical.issue: Service fee rounding differs from the UI. Python round() uses banker's rounding: round(28.5)=28, but JS Math.round(28.5)=29. Repro: sample-03, 3 days. UI booking-total shows $1,101 but the stored quote.total is $1,100, so the renter dashboard shows $1,100. Any rental where rent*days*0.1 ends in .5 is affected. Fix: in the backend use int(rental*0.10 + 0.5) or Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP.

minor.issue: Accepts requests for unavailable bags (sample-06 available=false returns 200). The UI disables the button, but the API does not enforce it.
city is not checked against MA_CITIES (a non-MA city like 'New York' returns 200), even though the spec says Massachusetts cities only. MA_CITIES is defined in server.py but never used.
There is no check for overlapping bookings or a maximum date range. This is acceptable for the prototype, but should be noted.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal page overflow: document scrollWidth is 456 at a 390 viewport. The sort label/select (w-[150px]) is pushed off-screen to the right and 'Recommended' is cut off.

Tapping 'Select dates' (href #booking) scrolls the booking card to y=0, under the sticky header, which hides the $/day row. Add scroll-margin-top to #booking. The button also keeps saying 'Select dates' after dates are chosen.

integration_issues.flow: Guest Request to rent/buy -> 'View in my account'
integration_issues.issue: A visitor who has not registered can send a request (success shown), but 'View in my account' leads to dashboard-signed-out. The request can never be seen, because the dashboard queries by the localStorage user's email. Requests are also lost if a registered user edits the email field in the dialog. Suggest: prompt registration, or save the dialog name/email as the concept user on submit.

issues: Each gallery alternates two different stock bags. For example, on sample-01 the Chanel Classic Flap 'Front' is a woman in a burgundy dress with a small clutch, while 'Back'/'Bottom' show a different black bag on a yellow background. The 'Front · background cleaned' view is a lifestyle shot, not a cleaned product shot.
sample-02 (Hermès, color Tan) shows a light-blue bag in its card and main image. The color and image do not match.
The first door snaps to x=0 with no left gutter: snap-start ignores px-5. Add scroll-pl-5 / scroll-padding.
The lender line ('Sophia M. · New lender · Cambridge, MA') wraps into a cramped 3-column layout at 2-col mobile widths.
'Sign out' is rendered in mixed case with different tracking, unlike the uppercase RENTING/LENDING tabs next to it.
City defaults to Boston instead of the registered user's city. Lender stat 'Active listings' counts listings that are still in review.

action_items: Make backend fee rounding match the frontend (round half up) so the stored quote.total equals the UI total
Fix mobile catalogue toolbar overflow (shrink or wrap the sort select below sm)
Make guest rental/purchase requests visible: auto-create the concept user from dialog name/email, or require registration
Backend: reject rental requests for available=false listings; validate city against MA_CITIES for registrations and listings
Optional: add scroll-margin-top on #booking, a scroll-padding gutter on the mobile doors row, and gallery images that match each bag's color/model
critical_code_review_comments: server.py fees_for: round() is banker's rounding, which differs from JS Math.round. The fee logic is also duplicated in BookingCard.quote. Consider calling /api/quote from the UI so there is one source of truth.
MA_CITIES is defined but unused in server.py
Catalogue fetches all listings and filters on the client. Fine for 12 items; the mode/brand query params on /api/listings go unused by the UI.
RequestDialog: the user's email can diverge from the localStorage user, which orphans the requests in the dashboard

Backend uses date.today() (server local time) while the client calendar uses local browser time. Around midnight, a client in another timezone could pick 'tomorrow' and still be valid; this is low risk.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows functional; 1 data mismatch, 1 mobile overflow, 1 guest-visibility gap)

test_credentials: None needed. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is an empty template. Registration is concept only (localStorage key jadori_concept_user).
seed_data_creation: Test records created with TEST_/test_ prefixed emails in newsletter, registrations, rental_requests, purchase_requests, lender_submissions, contact_messages
context_for_next_testing_agent: Container date is Nov 3 2026. Testids: gallery-next-button/gallery-prev-button (not gallery-next), contact success testid is contact-done, filter radios use filter-auth-verified/filter-availability-available. Filter sheet checkboxes need about 1s for the slide-in animation before clicking. Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest backend/tests/test_jadori_api.py. Two tests (unavailable bag, non-MA city) are expected to fail until the backend validation is added.
rca of the issue: Fee mismatch: in the backend, fees_for computes service = round(rental*0.10). Python 3 rounds half to even, so round(28.5)=28, while BookingCard.quote uses Math.round, which gives 29. Repro: /bag/sample-03 ($95/day), pick 3 days. The UI shows $1,101 and POST /api/quote returns total 1100. Mitigation: use int(rental*0.10 + 0.5) in the backend.
